notes: Modified cash basis; governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (pp6-9: General, Street, TIF, Bond Fund). Fund balances printed as 'Cash Basis Fund Balance'; ending_cash = Total Assets of the governmental funds statement (all cash items, p13); beginning cash not printed separately. Governmental spending is printed only by object (no function); statement lines take the function of the dominant fund (review). Transfers to Component Units 250.00 (General Fund) recorded as transfers_out; component unit excluded. Business-type (Water, Sewer) from the proprietary statement Total column (p10); receipts total = operating Use Fees + nonoperating net (computed). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds statement (p13, totals equal the government-wide figures), business-type from the Statement of Net Position (p1). Detail: General, Street, TIF and Bond fund receipts from the combined receipts budget and actual schedule (pp11-12; budget column covers the primary government total only, so budget_final null); disbursements for General, Street and TIF from p13 (budgeted disbursements printed only as fund totals: General 231,300, Street 896,600, TIF 10,000). The Bond Fund page of the disbursements schedule (report p30) is not in the trim, so Bond Fund expenditure detail (statement column: Dues and Fees 15.00, Principal 95,000.00, Interest 7,098.75 = 102,113.75) is not recorded. Utility detail from the proprietary budget and actual schedule (p14; budget column covers both funds combined, budget_final null); Water/Sewer receipt totals from the unaudited combined statement p15.
